headline_marked: [[War will expand]] if US restarts attacks, warns Iran military
headline: War will expand if US restarts attacks, warns Iran military
summary: Iran's military spokesman warns that if the US continues military action, especially airstrikes, the ongoing Middle East conflict will geographically broaden, claiming it has already spread to the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.
details: Iran's military has issued a stark warning, stating that renewed attacks by the United States would lead to a further expansion of the ongoing conflict in the Middle East.

Military spokesman Mohammad Akraminia conveyed this message in an interview on Iranian state television, as reported by AFP. He emphasized that if the Americans again fall for "Zionist deception" or collaborate with them, particularly by continuing the war through airstrikes, the conflict would broaden geographically.

Akraminia claimed that the war has already extended to the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a critical maritime chokepoint. In support of his assertion, he referenced recent military tensions between Yemen's Houthi rebels and Saudi Arabia.
He further stated that Iran's operational scope now encompasses the entire region, including US bases in Jordan and various Persian Gulf countries.

Akraminia characterized the current US position in the Middle East as "difficult and unstable." He suggested that Washington is actively seeking new strategies to navigate the complex regional dynamics.
Concluding his remarks, the Iranian official affirmed that the country is fully prepared for any potential alternatives and situations that may arise.

headline_marked: Acting President Hafiz Uddin [[pays tribute to Liberation War martyrs]] at National Memorial, Savar
headline: Acting President Hafiz Uddin pays tribute to Liberation War martyrs at National Memorial, Savar
summary: Hafiz Uddin Ahmad, who assumed office on Friday, honored the heroes of 1971 and is scheduled to pay respects to former leaders Ziaur Rahman and Khaleda Zia.
details: Acting President Hafiz Uddin Ahmad today paid tribute to the martyrs of the Liberation War at the National Memorial in Savar. This marks one of his first official duties since assuming the presidency.

Following the wreath-laying, the acting president observed a moment of silence in memory of the martyrs. He was also given a guard of honour by a contingent of the armed forces and later signed the visitors' book.

Later today, he is scheduled to pay tribute to former president Ziaur Rahman and former prime minister Begum Khaleda Zia. He will lay wreaths at their graves at the Zia Mausoleum in Zia Udyan, Sher-e-Bangla Nagar, Dhaka.
After these tribute programmes, he will proceed to Bangabhaban to carry out the regular official duties of the head of state. This signifies his full immersion into presidential responsibilities.

Hafiz Uddin assumed the responsibilities of acting president on Friday. He took on the role in his capacity as speaker of the Jatiya Sangsad, following the resignation of Mohammed Shahabuddin due to ill health.
caption:
Bangladesh's new Acting President Hafiz Uddin Ahmad began his tenure by honoring Liberation War martyrs at the National Memorial. He also plans to pay tribute to former leaders Ziaur Rahman and Khaleda Zia.

Acting President Hafiz Uddin Ahmad today paid tribute to the martyrs of the Liberation War at the National Memorial in Savar. This marks one of his first official duties since assuming the presidency.

Following the wreath-laying, the acting president observed a moment of silence in memory of the martyrs. He was also given a guard of honour by a contingent of the armed forces and later signed the visitors' book.

Later today, he is scheduled to pay tribute to former president Ziaur Rahman and former prime minister Begum Khaleda Zia. He will lay wreaths at their graves at the Zia Mausoleum in Zia Udyan, Sher-e-Bangla Nagar, Dhaka.

After these tribute programmes, he will proceed to Bangabhaban to carry out the regular official duties of the head of state. This signifies his full immersion into presidential responsibilities.

Hafiz Uddin assumed the responsibilities of acting president on Friday. He took on the role in his capacity as speaker of the Jatiya Sangsad, following the resignation of Mohammed Shahabuddin due to ill health.
